content.title: Primech AI signs lease agreement for deployment of HYTRON LITE
content.summary: Primech AI, a subsidiary of Primtech, announced the signing of a two-year lease agreement with one of the leading facility management service providers for the deployment of its HYTRON LITE autonomous bathroom cleaning robot at one of Singapore’s largest public hospitals. The two-year agreement represents a milestone in commercializing Primech AI’s robotics technology.
